protocol.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after each timed region
protocol.reproducibility: Each row points to the original experiment artifact; historical RGB rows are explicitly marked

copy_baseline_tum_real.note: Copy is the no-transport reference; warp metrics are recorded in the student row

latent_geometry_student_eth3d_zero_shot.note: Cross-domain evidence is positive but modest; this is not a claim of solved generalization

full_grid_confidence_routing.note: Full-grid routing uses confidence to select warp versus copy; it is distinct from projected-cell top-k gating

bonn_dynamic_gt_geometry.note: Dynamic-scene result is a hard negative for unconditional warp and motivates confidence/routing

latent_warp_renderer.note: Renderer-only measurement on synthetic aligned geometry

composable_single_frame_m1_side_proxy.scope: M1-side proxy; excludes M2 and full DiT

historical_rgb_v7_baseline.scope: Historical RGB-space v7 measurement; old runtime/measurement context, not a same-run H100 comparison

active_dit_proxy.scope: DiT-like active-query microbenchmark with resident K/V; not Matrix-Game end-to-end

quality_baselines: latent Geometry Head plus confidence routing
system_benchmarks: peak VRAM, parameters, throughput and p95 latency

full_matrix_game_dit.consequence: No full-DiT or end-to-end speedup claim is permitted

blocked_or_pending.same_environment_moge_measurement: Pending a genuinely idle GPU; local MoGe-2 and MoGe-3 checkpoints are available
blocked_or_pending.unified_m2_runtime: Pending a clean read-only M2 invocation on the same input/protocol
blocked_or_pending.resolution_and_chunk_sweep: Only partial VAE 1/4/12 and M1 batch 1/4 measurements are currently available

conclusion.fact: The latent M1 head and renderer are lightweight, and real TUM transport is substantially better than latent Copy.
conclusion.negative_result: Bonn dynamic scenes do not support unconditional warp superiority; cross-domain zero-shot gain on ETH3D is modest.
conclusion.engineering_conclusion: The current benchmark supports a promising M1-side efficiency path, but not yet a full end-to-end acceleration claim.
conclusion.next_experiment: When a GPU becomes genuinely idle: run local MoGe-2/MoGe-3 with the same image and repeat protocol, then isolate M2 and repair the Matrix-Game dependency environment without modifying M2 code.
